design: Chronological development folds entirely inside first 80% per ticker. Final 20% excluded. No parameter tuning on final segment.
variants: 20-bar breakout + SMA50 direction/slope filter; exits after 12/24/36 bars or cross of SMA50 (max 36 bars).
limitations: archive overlaps prior research; development folds are not independent fresh data
fees/spread/slippage/borrow/taxes not modeled; costs are illustrative
H1 bars; horizons measured in trading bars
one open trade per ticker; next entry only after prior exit
research only; no signals or orders
